name: RenderWare (Criterion) on XDK D3D8LTCG
_why: RECOMP_PB_WALK=dma: D3D8LTCG's fence wait (BlockOnTime and its far-behind probe) reads DMA_GET and the 0x0310
latch (PGRAPH 0x400B10), which only the DMA walk keeps honest; under the segment scan Burnout 3's front end
D3D builds its fence KEVENT itself (no KeInitializeEvent import) and software method 5 sets it
(profiles/xdk/d3d8/d3d8.c): title-built KEVENTs are guest events by default, so no RECOMP_TITLE_KEVENTS here.
RECOMP_GPU_FPS_CAP=60 and frame generation off: Criterion's game logic follows the flip rate (Burnout 3 runs at
half speed at a 30 cap, and frame generation at 2x on a 60 Hz panel caps at 30). XBA-96 is to detect that at
XBA_D3D_FENCE=mirror (the A/B fallback) wants the segment scan: set RECOMP_PB_WALK=scan with it.
Seen on: Burnout 3 4541005B. Picked for: Black 45410083 (XBA-92), any title tools.xbe_ident finds RenderWare in.
